top_signals.title: Griffiths: Seeing Confidence Return to Mideast Travel
top_signals.summary: Dubai International Airport saw 50.4m passengers in the first nine months of 2026, down 28.1% from a year earlier. Paul Griffiths, CEO of Dubai Airports spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on how the regional disruptions impacted their numbers. (Source: Bloomberg)
